params.message:
Admitting a source moves into the tool, with its terms looked up

Admitting was a command on the server: nothing in the Observatory could
do it, while the desk read and the guide sent people to the Sources page.
Trials passed and stayed where they were. A person now says what a
source's terms of use are, and the trial is decided by that: terms that
allow a paid product admit a trial that passed, terms that do not turn
it down.

Finding the terms was the slow part, so the engine does the looking: it
finds the page, a model reads it, and the suggestion is kept only when
the sentence it rests on is on that page. It is laid ready as a
suggestion and never written as the terms; nothing here admits.

Portal: De redactie kan een bron nu zelf toelaten in de Observatory. Het systeem zoekt de gebruiksvoorwaarden op en legt de gevonden zin klaar; een persoon leest en beslist.
